disease.label: SYNGAP1-Related Developmental and Epileptic Encephalopathy
disease.summary: SYNGAP1-related developmental and epileptic encephalopathy (also called SYNGAP1-related intellectual disability, MRD5) is an autosomal dominant neurodevelopmental disorder caused by haploinsufficiency of SYNGAP1, which encodes SynGAP - a Ras/Rap GTPase-activating protein highly enriched at excitatory postsynaptic densities. Essentially all affected individuals have developmental delay or intellectual disability;…
